1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network __at a server side of a traffic service network__; - assessing, __by the server side__, a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier; - assessing, __by the server side__, an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code; - determining, __by the server side__, whether the advertising reference code is present; and - generating, __by the server side__, a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present, __the advertising reference code comprising a substantially unique code identifying at least a portion of an advertisement stored on a recipient device of the traffic message__.
